title: CrashAPI
text: goal crashapi R package provide functions downloading data National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) Fatality Analysis Reporting System (FARS) API. FARS? NHTSA explains: “Fatality Analysis Reporting System (FARS) contains data vehicle crashes United States occur public roadway involve fatality.”

title: CrashAPI
text: can install development version crashapi using pak package:
code: pak::pkg_install("elipousson/crashapi")

what: Fatality Analysis Reporting System (FARS) API support
title: CrashAPI
text: Supported APIs package include: Get Crash List Information Get Crash Details Get Crashes Location Get Crashes Vehicle Get Summary Counts Get Variables Get Variable Attributes Get FARS Data Year Get Crashes Occupant APIs support XML, JSV, CSV, JSON output formats. package uses JSON exception get_fars_year() (supports downloading CSV files). reference, package also includes list terms NHTSA technical definitions fars_terms list variable labels fars_vars_labels. FARS API currently provides access data 2010 2024. NHTSA website also provides additional information release data version status FARS data files available API:

title: CrashAPI
text: According Data Index terminations tracker, February 2025 NHTSA renamed person-level gender variable “Sex” recoded third response value “Reported”, removing non-binary category published FARS data files. FARS 2022 release notes confirm February 11, 2025, NHTSA replaced attribute 3 attribute 8 (Reported), updating 22 records PERSON table 1 record PBTYPE table. See OMB ICR 202503-2127-008 Williams Institute report Removal SOGI Federal Data Collections (Feb 2026) information. Data now returned CrashAPI codes SEX 1 (Male), 2 (Female), 8 (Reported), 9 (Reported Unknown) years, people previously recorded non-binary now appear “Reported”.

title: CrashAPI
text: get_fars_zip() get_crss_zip() functions can used access FARS data files 1975 2024 CRSS data files 2016 2024 available via API available download NHTSA File Downloads site zipped CSV SAS files. Zipped CSV files converted parquet files cached user cache directory (see tools::R_user_dir()) data needs downloaded . site also provides extensive technical documentation coding use FARS data files. Earlier data along data General Estimates System (GES) / Crash Report Sampling System (CRSS) also available Fatality Injury Reporting System Tool (FIRST).

title: CrashAPI
text: Use get_fars() get FARS data table (e.g. accident, person, vehicle) one states, county, one years. Data state 2010 onwards comes CrashAPI national data data 2010 comes cached zipped data files. can set geometry TRUE convert accident table sf object mapping.  National data data 2010 downloaded cached first time used: CrashAPI endpoints available specific functions. example, can use get_fars_summary() access state-level summary data crash fatality counts.  can list crashes filter number vehicles involved get_fars_crash_list(). call get_fars_crashes() details set TRUE, additional information get_fars_cases() (including crash date time) appended crash data frame.

text: state One state names, abbreviations, FIPS numbers. NULL (default), returns national data. Lowercase uppercase values permitted. available tables vary year source; see get_fars_year() tables available CrashAPI. county County name FIPS number. Requires single state. source Source data: "auto" (default), "api" CrashAPI, "zip" zipped data files. ... Additional parameters passed get_fars_zip() data comes zipped data files, e.g. path, overwrite, keep_files. geometry TRUE, return sf object. supported tables LATITUDE LONGITUD columns (e.g. accident). crs Coordinate reference system use geometry TRUE. labels TRUE (default), add "label" attribute column variable label fars_vars_labels. title: Get Crashes By Occupant — get_fars_crash_persons
text: function returns list people involved fatal crashes match specific age, sex, seat position, injury severity using CrashAPI GetCrashesByPerson endpoint. returned data one row person.

title: Get Crashes By Occupant — get_fars_crash_persons
code: get_fars_crash_persons(   state,   age,   sex,   seat,   injury,   year = getOption("crashapi.year", 2024),   labels = TRUE )

title: Get Crashes By Occupant — get_fars_crash_persons
text: state Required. State name, abbreviation, FIPS number. age Required. Age years. sex Required. Code name person's sex: 1 ("Male"), 2 ("Female"), 8 ("Reported"), 9 ("Reported Unknown"). "m", "f", "unknown" also accepted. seat Required. Code name person's seat position, e.g. 11 "Front Seat, Left Side" ("front left" also accepted). Use 0 "Motor Vehicle Occupant" non-occupants. See FARS Analytical User's Manual seat position codes. injury Required. Code name person's injury severity: 0 ("Apparent Injury (O)"), 1 ("Possible Injury (C)"), 2 ("Suspected Minor Injury (B)"), 3 ("Suspected Serious Injury ()"), 4 ("Fatal Injury (K)"), 5 ("Injured, Severity Unknown"), 6 ("Died Prior Crash"), 9 ("Unknown/Reported"). Short names (e.g. "fatal") KABCO letters (e.g. "K") also accepted. year numeric vector. One years 2010 2024. minimum maximum values used start end year. Defaults getOption("crashapi.year", 2024). labels TRUE (default), add "label" attribute column variable label fars_vars_labels. Labels shown View() RStudio Positron used packages gt gtsummary.

title: Get Crashes By Occupant — get_fars_crash_persons
text: NHTSA's documentation says endpoint accepts "one " occupant details age, sex, seat position, injury severity. However, testing October 2026 found API behave way: API returns error (HTTP 404) unless four provided, error message blank, returns people match four values exactly. reason, age, sex, seat, injury required. endpoint's includeOccupants includeNonOccupants parameters supported since required seat position already determines whether occupants non-occupants returned (use seat = 0 people motor vehicle occupants). find people using criteria (e.g. range ages injury severity), download person table get_fars_year() using type = "person" filter data.

title: Get crash data from the CrashAPI — get_fars_crashes
text: functions access specific endpoints DOT NHTSA's CrashAPI: get_fars_crashes returns list fatal crashes county. get_fars_cases returns details one fatal crashes case number. get_fars_crash_list returns list fatal crashes occurred one states range vehicles involved. get_fars_summary provides count crashes fatalities year state. get_fars_year provides FARS data table state. get_fars_crash_list get_fars_crashes limit returned data 5000 records consider limiting range years requested data exceeds threshold. Use get_fars() get FARS data tables state, county, year (including national data years 2010) CrashAPI NHTSA data downloads site.

title: Get crash data from the CrashAPI — get_fars_crashes
code: get_fars_crashes(   state,   county,   year = getOption("crashapi.year", 2024),   details = FALSE,   geometry = FALSE,   crs = NULL,   labels = TRUE )  get_fars_cases(   state,   cases,   year = getOption("crashapi.year", 2024),   details = FALSE,   geometry = FALSE,   crs = NULL,   labels = TRUE )  get_fars_crash_list(   state,   year = getOption("crashapi.year", 2024),   vehicles = c(1, 50),   labels = TRUE )  get_fars_summary(state, year = getOption("crashapi.year", 2024), labels = TRUE)  get_fars_year(   state,   year = getOption("crashapi.year", 2024),   type = "accident",   format = "json",   path = NULL,   geometry = FALSE,   crs = NULL,   download = FALSE,   labels = TRUE,   call = caller_env() )

title: Get crash data from the CrashAPI — get_fars_crashes
text: state Required. State name, abbreviation, FIPS number. get_fars_crash_list supports multiple states. county County name FIPS number. Required get_fars_crashes. year numeric vector. One years. get_fars_crashes, get_fars_crash_list, get_fars_summary, get_fars_year, minimum maximum values used start end year, year = 2015:2020 year = c(2015, 2020) request data 2015 2020 (message year gaps). get_fars_cases, year must single year one year case cases. CrashAPI supports years 2010 2024. Defaults getOption("crashapi.year", 2024) default year can set functions options(crashapi.year = 2022). details get_fars_crashes, TRUE, detailed case data (excluding event vehicle data) joined crash data. get_fars_cases, TRUE, event vehicle data included list columns, use "events" "vehicles" return event vehicle data cases. Default: FALSE. geometry TRUE, return sf object. Optional get_fars_crashes. crs Coordinate reference system return get_fars_crashes geometry TRUE. labels TRUE (default), add "label" attribute column variable label fars_vars_labels. Labels shown View() RStudio Positron used packages gt gtsummary. cases One FARS case numbers. Required get_fars_cases. vehicles numeric vector minimum maximum number vehicles, e.g. c(1, 2) minimum 1 vehicle maximum 2. Required get_fars_crash_list. type Name FARS data table. Supported values include "ACCIDENT", "CEVENT", "DAMAGE", "DISTRACT", "DRIMPAIR", "DRUGS", "FACTOR", "MANEUVER", "NMCRASH", "NMIMPAIR", "NMPRIOR", "PARKWORK", "PBTYPE", "PERSON", "SAFETYEQ", "VEHICLE", "VEVENT", "VINDECODE", "VINDERIVED", "VIOLATION", "VISION", "VSOE". "TRAILERVINDERIVED" supported 2016 onwards, "NMDISTRACT" "RACE" 2019 onwards, "CRASHRF", "DRIVERRF", "PERSONRF", "PVEHICLESF", "VEHICLESF", "WEATHER" 2020 onwards get_fars_year. Lowercase mixed case values permitted. format Format request CrashAPI get_fars_year ("json" "csv"). Default: "json". path Directory save file download TRUE get_fars_year. download logical. TRUE, get_fars_year downloads data file instead returning data frame. Default FALSE. call execution environment currently running function, e.g. caller_env(). function mentioned error messages source error. See call argument abort() information.

title: crashapi (development version)
text: Breaking change: get_fars() redesigned return FARS data table (e.g. accident, person, vehicle) one states, optional county, one years, similar stats19::get_stats19(). Data state 2010 onwards comes CrashAPI national data, Puerto Rico, data 2010 comes zipped data files (set source choose). Tables filtered county directly matching crashes county accident table. api, cases, vehicles, details, format, pr, path, download arguments removed; use get_fars_crashes(), get_fars_cases(), get_fars_crash_list(), get_fars_summary(), get_fars_year() CrashAPI endpoints. Breaking change: get_fars_zip() get_crss_zip() now convert zipped CSV files parquet files cached user cache directory (getOption("crashapi.cache_dir")) remove zip CSV files unless keep_files = TRUE. Later calls read cached files without downloading data unless overwrite = TRUE. read = FALSE, return parquet file paths named table (list named year multiple years). crashapi now imports nanoparquet. crashapi now requires R 4.1.0 later, matching dependencies use native pipe. Fix package use current CrashAPI base URL browser headers (broken since January 2025). Breaking change: required arguments now come year get_fars_crashes() (state, county), get_fars_cases() (state, cases), get_fars_crash_list(), get_fars_summary(), get_fars_year(), get_fars_crash_vehicles() (state, make, model, model_year, body_type), get_fars_crash_persons() (state, age, sex, seat, injury). Calls pass year position need name . get_fars_crash_persons() now works. age, sex, seat, injury required since CrashAPI returns error unless four provided (contrary NHTSA’s documentation), names (e.g. sex = "female", seat = "front left", injury = "fatal") converted codes. occupants nonoccupants arguments removed since seat position determines whether occupants non-occupants returned. get_fars_crash_vehicles() now requires make, model, model_year, body_type since CrashAPI returns error unless four provided, accepts names numeric IDs make, model, body_type (previously character IDs worked). Data 2024 (released April 2026) now supported default year functions getOption("crashapi.year", 2024). Use options(crashapi.year = 2022) set different default year session. Breaking change: start_year end_year arguments removed. Functions API endpoints take range years (get_fars_crashes(), get_fars_crash_list(), get_fars_summary(), get_fars_year(), get_fars_crash_vehicles(), get_fars_crash_persons()) now use minimum maximum year start end year, message year gaps. fars_vars() supports multiple years returns year column. get_fars_crashes() errors clear message county missing. get_fars() get_fars_crashes() now error county can’t matched county state (e.g. ambiguous name like “Baltimore” invalid FIPS code) instead filtering state FIPS code returning rows.
